title: catalyst runtime status
description: What `catalyst runtime status --json` prints: the catalyst running, the per-version runtimes under the home, the launcher, and the catalyst in the current project's criterion.

runtimes.description: The versions installed under the home's runtimes.

criterion.description: The current project's criterion; null outside a project.

criterion_runtime.description: The catalyst in the criterion's `.venv`; null when it has none.
